_README: ML30+ items validated against their DDO wiki page (source of truth). This file is BOTH the record and the resumable worklist for the wiki-validation loop: an item present here with `confirmed` set is skipped on re-runs. `affixes` documents the magnitude affixes read from the wiki `enhancements` field ({{Stat|value|type}} templates); `corrections` records any dataset change applied (wiki wins). `notes` capture procs/set/augment context. Method: MediaWiki query API via Claude-in-Chrome (ddowiki blocks plain fetch). Scope target: 1809 distinct ML30+ items. build_dataset stamps `wiki_confirmed` onto matching items from this file.

_meta.method: ddowiki MediaWiki query API (prop=revisions rvslots=main) via Claude-in-Chrome; parse the {{...}} templates in the `enhancements` field
_meta.policy: wiki is source of truth; on mismatch correct the dataset via the seed/pipeline and log it under `corrections` (never edit generated web/data/items.json)

cross_check_2026_08_01.method: offline diff of the optimizer catalog vs two independent wiki-mirrors: illusionistpm/ddo-gear-planner (JSON, near-daily) + Maetrim/DDOBuilderV2 (per-item XML). Compared normalized (stat->value) magnitude affixes for all 1809 ML30+ items.
cross_check_2026_08_01.result: 1809 ML30+ items -> only 4 genuine value conflicts (same stat, different value). The other ~1805 agree or differ only in representation (Shield+Protection vs Armor Class; True Seeing+Blindness Immunity vs Eversight) or booleans/procs the pipeline drops (KTD6).
cross_check_2026_08_01.coverage_note: DBv2 has NO ML35 tier (231 items exist only in gear-planner) and only 11 ML36; so ML35 raid gear has no independent cross-check and needs wiki verification.
cross_check_2026_08_01.catalog_freshness: optimizer catalog derives from an older gear-planner snapshot (mine ~8091 vs gp-latest 8188 items); values largely match, so staleness is minimal for magnitudes.
